part5.authority_note: Dkt. 77 (entered 4/14) is an INTERIM PROCEDURES order, not a §330(a) fee award: monthly statements, 14-day objection window, absent objection the Debtor may pay 80% of fees + 100% of expenses; the 20% holdback is payable only upon Court approval of an interim or final fee application; NO payment for any period before the professional's retention date. All amounts remain subject to final fee review and disgorgement (§§330(a)/331; bc_330_331.md).
